settings.languageHelp: Language of the page titles, descriptions and content. Each scope has one llms.txt and one llms-full.txt.
settings.baseUrlHelp: Scheme, host and optional port that the links in both files start with, for example https://www.example.com. Saved with the files.

generating.title: Generating
generating.index: Reading the published pages of the site.

generated.title: Generated from {{pages}} pages in {{language}}
generated.review: The text below was replaced by this proposal. Review and edit it, then select Save and publish. Discard changes restores the saved file.
generated.advice: This text is the pages of the site put end to end, as they are published. Proofreading it, rewriting what reads badly and removing what does not help is strongly advised before publishing: a file that was curated serves AI assistants, and so your visibility in their answers (GEO), far better than a raw one.
generated.failed: Pages that could not be rendered, left out of the file ({{count}}):

cut.pages: The site has more pages than one file lists: the pages nearest to the home page were kept. To describe more of it, give its large sections files of their own (Files of, above): this file then links to them.
cut.size: The file reached its size limit: the last {{count}} pages were left out. To have them, generate the files of a section, or ask an administrator for a higher limit (maxFullKb).
cut.time: The time allowed for one generation ran out: the pages not rendered in time were left out.

notification.saved: The files were saved and published.

error.read: The llms.txt settings of this site could not be read.
error.generate: The file could not be generated.
error.save: The files could not be saved.

disabled.title: llms.txt is not available on this site
disabled.text: Enable the llms.txt manager module on the site, and make sure you have the publish permission on it.

config.title: What this site lists
config.description: These values apply to the llms.txt and llms-full.txt of this site only. An empty field keeps the default of this Jahia, named under it. A change applies to the next generation: a file already saved stays as it is until it is generated and published again.
config.inherit: Empty: the default of this Jahia ({{value}}).

maxPages.label: Pages listed
maxPages.help: Most pages one file lists, from {{min}} to {{max}}. When the site has more, the pages nearest to the home page are kept. Each listed page is rendered for llms-full.txt: a large number makes its generation long.

maxDepth.label: Page depth
maxDepth.help: Levels of pages below the home page that are listed, from {{min}} to {{max}}. Menu groups do not count as a level.

maxMainResources.label: Contents shown as a page
maxMainResources.help: Most contents displayed as a page of their own (news, articles) listed after the pages, the most recent first, from {{min}} to {{max}}. 0 lists none.

includedNodeTypes.label: List only marked pages
includedNodeTypes.help: Node types (mixins), separated by commas. When set, only the pages that carry one of them are listed. jmix:llmsListed is the option List in llms.txt of a page; the content editor shows it to the roles that hold the permission of that name. Type none to list every page on this site.

excludedNodeTypes.label: Pages left out
excludedNodeTypes.help: Node types (mixins) of the pages left out, separated by commas, for example jseomix:noIndex. Their sub-pages are still listed. The list replaces the default one: repeat the types to keep. Type none to leave no page out.

excludedTreeNodeTypes.label: Sections left out
excludedTreeNodeTypes.help: Node types (mixins) of the pages left out with all their sub-pages, separated by commas. Type none to leave no section out.

linkToMarkdown.label: Links of llms.txt
linkToMarkdown.help: Yes: each line of llms.txt links to the Markdown version of the page (page.html.md), as the llms.txt proposal recommends. No: it links to the page. Choose No when another tool compares these links with the addresses of the pages.

keepImages.label: Images in llms-full.txt
keepImages.help: Yes: the images of a page that have a text alternative are written. No: images are left out, a reader of text gains little from them.

config.saved: The settings of the site were saved. They apply to the next generation.
config.server: The limits that protect the server (pages rendered at the same time, timeouts, file sizes) are the same for every site. An administrator of the server sets them in the OSGi configuration org.jahia.modules.llms.

errors.summary: {{count}} values to correct. Nothing was saved.

errors.types: Error: not a node type of this Jahia: {{detail}}.
